issue.title: Finish Pomodoro homes — contract parity, review time, override labels, and panel fixes
issue.description: Close the gaps the bob-cli-9k landing review found between the shipped Pomodoro homes feature and its approved plan (plan:202610/pomodoro_homes.md). Rust and the bob-ledger-tools mirror agree on every shared vector. The review_time tile always equals the GTD review row. Stats theme parts are unchanged when no home filter applies. `bob ref today`, human `bob plan`, and the `=` override surfaces that landed during the epic label unnamed sessions by their derived homes. The Stats panel follows chart pins. Bob Mac Capture never routes by a derived label and draws forecast dots hollow.
